title: Drive to Kyzart & horse-ride to Kilemche
desc: We set off from Bishkek to Kyzart Village, in the hills below Song-Kol. A home-cooked lunch and a few riding pointers at a family homestay get you ready for the saddle.

The afternoon ride follows the Chaar-Archa River through open valleys and gentle mountain country to Kilemche. By evening you reach a nomad family's yurt camp, your home for a first quiet night in the hills.
meals: Lunch at guesthouse, dinner at yurt

title: Horse-ride to Song-Kol Lake
desc: Today's ride asks more of you, climbing toward the Jalgyz-Karagai Pass at 3300 m. The steady effort is repaid at the top with sweeping mountain views.
From the pass you descend to a yurt for lunch, then ride west along the lakeshore past nomad settlements to the Tuz-Ashuu pasture, where you stay the night.

title: Ride to the western shore of Song-Kol
desc: An easier day in the saddle, riding the smooth lakeside grass where your guide may pick up the pace to a canter or gallop.
By midday you reach the Ozbek-Ashuu pasture and lunch with a nomad family. The afternoon is yours: walk the shore, watch herder life, or take a short ride into the nearby hills before dinner.

title: Ride back to Kyzart & drive to Ysyk-Kol
desc: You leave the lake over the scenic Ozbek-Ashuu Pass at 3300 m, with a last view of Song-Kol before the trail drops down to Kyzart Village. Lunch and a rest follow.
In the afternoon you drive south to Ysyk-Kol along the scenic shore, with an optional sunset stop at the Fairy-Tale Canyons, ending at a guesthouse in Bokonbaev Village.
meals: Breakfast at yurt, lunch & dinner at guesthouse

title: Ride to Boz-Salkyn pasture
desc: The second half of the trip opens with a gentle ride through the village toward the Boz-Salkyn summer pastures, where nomad families spend the warmer months.
After lunch in a welcoming yurt, you ride on to the Shatyly viewpoint for a wide panorama of Ysyk-Kol framed by snow-capped peaks, then return by a different trail to the yurt camp.
meals: Breakfast at guesthouse, picnic lunch, dinner at yurt

title: Ride to Kok-Bulak pasture
desc: A demanding climb takes you up to the Karaly-Archa Pass at 2900 m through alpine forest, opening to broad views of Ysyk-Kol and the peaks of the Terskey Ala-Too range.
After a rest you descend to the Tuura-Suu River, where the horses graze and you take a picnic by the water. The afternoon ride, the lake glinting in the distance, ends at the Kok-Bulak yurt camp.
meals: Breakfast at guesthouse, picnic lunch, dinner at yurt

title: Ride to Bokonbaev & return to Bishkek
desc: The last ride descends through a scenic gorge back to Bokonbaev Village. There you meet local eagle hunters, who show the old craft of hunting with a bird, with time for photos.
After a closing lunch at the guesthouse you part with your horses and drive back to Bishkek, arriving in the evening at the end of seven days on the trail.
meals: Breakfast at yurt, lunch at guesthouse
